verdicts.note: Cloister courtyard with two-storey stone arcade, balustrade and tiled roofs; French Romanesque church.
Railway station with tracks, catenary and a platform sign reading CHALAIS; French station building.
Three stained-glass windows in a stone church wall showing saints; French chapel.
Stone arch bridge over a river with market stalls and parasols set up on it.
Romanesque church portal with densely carved archivolts, colonnettes and a red wooden door.
Village church facade with bell tower, two arched louvres and a clock.
Close-up of a carved tympanum relief with figures under a dense ornamented archivolt.
Stone castle with steep roof, turrets and a drawbridge over a dry moat.
Close-up of a railway platform edge with tactile strip next to two tracks on ballast.
Plain stone church facade with round-arched arcades and a statue niche against blue sky.
Half-timbered French houses with tile roofs; street plate reads RUE E BON, house no 13.
Cable-car station painted blue and white, sign reads Vercorin Chalais Brice, alpine valley behind.
